About LP Roofing Ltd

Run by Lee Pinder, with a team of 6 working from Clayton-le-Moors across Lancashire and the Fylde coast.

Meet The Owner

How LP Roofing Started

Lee started out on his own 16 years ago and has 27 years' experience. LP Roofing Ltd was set up in 2014.

Today it's a team of 6 at Junction 7 Business Park in Clayton-le-Moors, doing pitched roofs, flat roofs, uPVC roofline and emergency repairs for homeowners and commercial customers.

"We have over 100 years combined experience in slating, tiling and flat roof systems."
Lee PinderDirector, LP Roofing Ltd

Why LP Roofing

What Makes Us Different

  1. 01

    Over 100 Years Between Us

    That's the combined experience across the team, in slating, tiling and flat roof systems.

  2. 02

    Qualified

    The team holds NVQ level 2 in flat roofs, and NVQ level 2 and 3 in building and insulation.

  3. 03

    Insured

    We hold £5,000,000 public liability insurance.

  4. 04

    Open 24 Hours

    Emergency repairs are usually done in a day. See emergency repairs.

  5. 05

    Short Times on Site

    A flat roof usually takes 1 to 2 days and a pitched roof 3 to 5 days.
